newsitem.title: UK: Next extends gain amid talk of upgrades.
newsitem.headline: Next extends gain amid talk of upgrades.

text.p: Shares in Next Plc extended early gains by late morning on Wednesday, amid talk of analyst upgrades following top-of-range profits and a positive presentation by company executives, dealers said.
The stock was up 26p at 622 by 1126 GMT in active trade of just under two million shares.
Dealers and analysts said forecasts for the current year would probably be raised by about ten million stg, from their previous level around 180 million stg.
"They were good figures and everyone will be upping by about ten million stg," said the head of equity trading at one brokerage.
With pre-tax profits rising 12 percent to 159 million stg, Next chief executive David Jones said the company was gaining market share, though he expected margins to be stable over the coming year.
"It was an admirable set of figures and the meeting was very upbeat," said analyst Iain McDonald at Charterhouse Tilney.

"The question is where do they go from here," McDonald said, "it may be difficult to add meaningfully to store space and they are accumulating a large cash pile, which will be a drag on earnings and could tempt them to spend in a silly manner."
"But the historic numbers were very good and should be applauded."
